listing.name: Hollow Knight / HK: Dual Souls (igawa6)
listing.summary: Explore Hollow Knight / HK: Dual Souls (igawa6) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Keep a permitted prepared copy
steps.instruction: For an already obtained permitted copy, follow this fork’s on-device Import Game flow with your own complete Hollow Knight GOG/Steam v1.5.12620 Voidheart folder and its matching release patch. The folder contains Hollow Knight_Data or hollow_knight_Data. Choose the game folder and patch, then Build game data and START GAME. Do not substitute another game version or describe the published patch as containing no game content.

steps.title: Keep your data when changing versions
steps.instruction: The upstream Save Files page exports/imports slots; saves use Android/data/igawa6.dualsouls/files and imports retain the previous slot as .bak. Preserve an export before changing the app. Upstream says to update over the same signed app and never uninstall first: uninstall or Clear storage deletes saves and built data. A required data rebuild uses the matching new patch; PC save wrapping is not directly compatible.

listing.download_block_reason: The selected upstream README states that the APK contains Hollow Knight compiled game code; its redistribution audit also identifies the patch as carrying game content. No publisher permission for that distribution is established here. Fresh Portcove downloads remain unavailable until an attributable grant or a package that creates those materials from the player’s own inputs resolves this boundary. Existing permitted copies keep their files and upstream ownership.
